desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: Funny Avatar Tower! 😂

Choose between two doors every stage and build the most CURSED avatar possible 💀
Some choices make you look amazing…
others will completely ruin your character 😭

Unlock crazy combinations:
🎩 funny hats
👕 weird outfits
👀 cursed faces
🦶 goofy accessories
🤡 troll items & more

Every run is different with MILLIONS of chaotic avatar combinations 🎲

Can you survive the tower and create the funniest avatar at the top? 😆
Compare your final look with friends and see who got the most cursed style

👍 Like the game + join the group for extra perks
